items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mr. Baroni was an Italian, elder gentleman who taught piano and so I studied with Mr. Baroni.

ctx.x: Joy Goines was her name. She was really great, she had a nice relationship with the students and everything like that. She formed a choir whatever you want to call it, chorus, choir whatever. She would conduct that and rehearse us in that respect, and at the same time I was taking piano lessons and Mr. Baroni was an Italian, elder gentleman who taught piano and so I studied with Mr. Baroni.
Do you remember what originally inspired you to want to play the piano?
